seoTitle: Best Damn RSS Feed to JSON API: RSS, Atom, JSON Feed
seoDescription: Convert RSS, Atom and JSON Feed URLs into clean JSON items with content, authors, dates, images and podcast enclosures. $0.0005 per item; failed feeds free.

feed-item.eventDescription: One feed item normalized to JSON (title, link, author, dates, HTML and plain-text content, categories, enclosures, image). Feeds that cannot be found, fetched or parsed are not charged.
